- Days with at least 25 mm of rain: 11.5 days/yr.
- Average yearly maximum 3-day rainfall: 125.0 mm. The wettest 3 days in the period were 241 mm, in 2022.
- FEMA county flood frequency: 4.61 events/yr, at the 93.2nd US county percentile.

If the concern is severe weather more broadly, the unscored FEMA context is high. Tornado frequency is 0.928 events/yr (96.4th percentile) and hail is 8.92 events/yr (96.9th percentile). Ice storms are 1.23 events/yr (88.5th percentile). These are not part of the score. Tornado counts are county-wide, so compare them across hubs with care.
